title: EXP-020 — Button Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Form-Tab Close and Recent-Forms Reopen
objective: Observe the path-specific recovery of a saved Button Caption across an ordinary Web Designer Form-tab close followed by Form-menu recent-forms reopen in the same Designer/session context, without page reload or explicit unload. Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 using the replay-verified EXP-019-R2 selection prefix followed by the independently verified basic-form creation suffix. Their end-to-end composition is an assumption to test during creation, not an already replay-verified combined creation path. Add exactly one Button, complete its required setup including assigning Name FX_CaptionButton, then capture the AC-3 pre-Caption baseline. After that baseline, intentionally change only Caption to Button Caption Close Only, ordinary-save exactly once to clean, close the Form through its normal Form-tab control, and reopen it through the supported Form-menu recent-forms path. Compare the same User-scoped Form and Button against the baseline. Button Caption recovery across full-page reload/reopen is already established separately by EXP-003 and EXP-003-R2. This experiment tests only the ordinary Form-tab close/recent-forms boundary and may conclude no more than that the saved Caption was visibly recovered unchanged after this sequence in the same Designer/session context. Do not infer general Button persistence, physical database durability, cache eviction, unload behavior, or why recovery occurred.

acceptance_checks.description: Preflight visibly proves a live User-scope Designer session requiring no authentication recovery; any inherited empty EXP-019-R2 wizard page is visibly cancelled through its normal Cancel flow; no creation dialog remains; and `FX_ButtonCaptionLab01` is proven absent before mutation. Evidence must show the User scope and absence result.

Exactly one FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 is created in User scope by the replay-verified selection prefix followed by the independently verified basic-form creation suffix, with Save Template unchecked. Evidence visibly identifies the created Form and User scope and shows it clean. The composed end-to-end creation procedure is not labeled replay-verified; success of that composition is only observed here.

Exactly one Button is placed and all required component-creation/setup steps, including assigning Name FX_CaptionButton, are completed before this baseline. Capture the intended Form identity/User scope and selected Button. Record the actual supported visible property labels, units and values for Name, Type/class (use the displayed semantic label, not generated IDs or internal codes), Left, Top, Width, Height, and current Caption. Record any additional explicitly inspected non-Caption comparison properties. No Caption edit has yet occurred in this experiment. If these baseline values cannot be established through permitted visible surfaces, record a blocker rather than guessing or accessing internals.

After the AC-3 baseline, the only intentional Button-property mutation is Caption to exactly Button Caption Close Only, followed by exactly one ordinary Designer Save. Visible evidence before Save and after Save ties the exact Caption to FX_CaptionButton on the target Form, shows all recorded non-Caption baseline properties unchanged, and establishes the post-Save Designer is clean. The earlier Name assignment belongs to pre-baseline setup and does not contradict the Caption-only mutation boundary.

`FX_ButtonCaptionLab01` is closed through its ordinary Form-tab close control with no unsaved-change or other unexpected prompt, and no explicit unload, preference change, Regenerate, authentication recovery, or session replacement occurs.

The target reopens through the supported Form-menu recent-forms path in the same Designer/session context, without explicit unload or page reload. Decisive evidence identifies the same User-scoped Form by Name + ScopeType + ScopeName and the selected FX_CaptionButton with Caption exactly Button Caption Close Only. This supports only visible recovery across the stated UI boundary.

Post-reopen visible evidence shows the target Designer clean. Compare against AC-3: Name, displayed Type/class, Left, Top, Width, Height, and every additional non-Caption property explicitly recorded in that baseline match their recorded values. Caption equals the saved Button Caption Close Only value from AC-4. Use semantic values on supported visible surfaces rather than generated IDs, stale internal models, or guessed type codes.

Final audit proves exactly one case-insensitive FX_ButtonCaptionLab01 exists, records the exact ordinary Form-tab close/recent-forms reopen sequence and evidence, confirms no prohibited action occurred, and confines repository changes to the EXP-020 record plus evidence/EXP-020/. Classify success no higher than observed and use this bounded conclusion: the saved Button Caption was visibly recovered unchanged after this ordinary Form-tab close/recent-forms reopen sequence in the same Designer/session context. Acknowledge the separate EXP-003/EXP-003-R2 reload evidence and exclude general Button persistence, physical database durability, cache eviction, unload behavior, causal explanations, and promotion of the composed creation path to replay-verified.
